- **Prompt Engineering**: The process of designing effective prompts for AI models, with an emphasis on creating custom prompts rather than relying on AI-generated ones [28 July 2026, Page 27 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Architecture**: Discussion on how external intelligence pipelines, machine learning models, and statistical analyses (like STF) run outside the prompt but need to be integrated into the prompt for the AI model to utilize them, similar to how RAG content is brought into a prompt [28 July 2026, Page 30 — Dakshinya Nachimuthu, Siddharth Saminathan].
- **Caching Mechanisms**: Importance of caching (embedding, LLM, and prompt caching) to reduce embedding costs and improve efficiency, explained with an analogy of computer applications staying open for quick access [30 July 2026, Page 1 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- **Evaluation Frameworks**: The necessity of developing and using robust evaluation frameworks, backed by first principles, to assess AI model results, with a strong emphasis on evidence-based validation [21 July 2026, Page 3 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- **Orchestration Frameworks**: Discussion on the role of orchestrators in managing tasks within an agent system and the capabilities of different LLMs (e.g., GPT 3.5, GPT 4.1) [15 July 2026, Page 9 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- **Metadata Filtering in Qdrant**: How Qdrant performs metadata filtering and when to use it [31 July 2026, Page 11 — Siddharth Saminathan].
- **Chunking Strategies**: Learning about different chunking strategies and their effectiveness in retrieval [31 July 2026, Page 11 — Siddharth Saminathan].
